milestones: Site preparation and excavation
Grading or excavation can be visible. Confirm the footprint and excavation date with a site record.
Substructure
Piles, foundations and basements as applicable. Use inspection records to establish completion.
Superstructure
Structural frame and slabs. The visible footprint can change while the number of completed floors remains uncertain.
Roof and façade
Exterior enclosure. Use a dated façade or roof inspection to confirm scope and completion.
Building services and internal finishes
Mechanical, electrical and plumbing (MEP), lifts and interiors. Use contractor or consultant reports.
Testing, certification and handover
Keep commissioning records, the building completion certificate and unit handover as separate milestones.
Setting out and excavation
Use a surveyed plot and dated site record to identify the individual villa.
Substructure
Foundations and below-ground works. Confirm with the applicable inspection.
Superstructure and roof
Above-ground structure and roof coverage. Use close imagery or inspection for the individual unit.
Building services and finishes
MEP, internal finishes and exterior finishes can overlap. Confirm by unit and work package.
External works
Driveway, paths, landscaping and boundary walls where applicable.
Testing, certification and handover
Use unit-specific signoffs and handover records.
Enabling works and grading
Clearance, grading and access can be assessed across a verified phase.
Roads and utility infrastructure
Track visible road alignment separately from buried utilities and service commissioning.
Residential construction by phase
Track villa plots or clusters individually. Foundation, structure and finishes may overlap across phases.
Public realm and amenities
Track parks, paths and amenities separately from home delivery.
Phased handover
Track which phase has begun handovers and which infrastructure and amenities are still outstanding.
Enabling works and substructure
Track excavation, foundations and applicable basements.
Superstructure
Track main frame and structural steel. A structural progress figure applies to that work package.
Roof, skylights and façade
Compare enclosure and roof extent with dated images and installation records.
Building services, common areas and tenant fit-out
Track landlord and tenant scopes separately. Confirm by package or unit.
Testing, certification and opening
Use commissioning and approval records. Opening can precede some tenant openings.
